verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway with an admin UI, spend tracking and logging. Such a product could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on usage data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only raw spend tracking, logging exports, traffic mirroring for evaluation and a memory store. Nothing shows the product itself generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
